records.summary: Characters in Multiversal are shaped by their experiences. Over time, surviving harsh conditions and enduring major injuries can harden a characterʼs body, granting them the chance to become more resilient—but only after sufficient hardship. Unlike XP purchases at character creation, increasing health during gameplay is conditional, reflecting earned resilience through pain and endurance.

description: Characters in Multiversal are shaped by their experiences. Over time, surviving harsh conditions and enduring major injuries can harden a characterʼs body, granting them the chance to become more resilient—but only after sufficient hardship. Unlike XP purchases at character creation, increasing health during gameplay is conditional, reflecting earned resilience through pain and endurance.
conditions for gaining health via xp: Characters cannot freely buy HP increases during gameplay. Instead, they may become eligible for HP upgrades if the following criteria are met:
damage threshold: The character must have received a significant amount of damage in a single session or event, qualifying them for potential health growth. TierDamage TakenXP Buy UnlockedSmall IncreaseAt least 50% of max HP+5 HP optionMajor IncreaseAt least 75% of max HP+10 HP option
full rest required: The HP increase only applies after the character completes a long rest (uninterrupted full recovery), symbolizing physical adaptation and healing.
one hp purchase per rest: A character can only gain one HP upgrade per rest cycle, even if they qualify for both.
xp costs post creation: Once a character qualifies, they may spend XP to gain permanent HP increases:

records.summary: Your characterʼs health is a measure of their physical resilience, toughness, and capacity to survive wounds, exertion, and extreme conditions. In Multiversal, health (HP) is not only determined by your Constitution but can also be increased at character creation by spending XP from your starting pool.

description: Your characterʼs health is a measure of their physical resilience, toughness, and capacity to survive wounds, exertion, and extreme conditions. In Multiversal, health (HP) is not only determined by your Constitution but can also be increased at character creation by spending XP from your starting pool.
constitution starting hp: At creation, a characterʼs starting HP is: 10 or their Constitution score, whichever is higher.

records.proposedName: 3.Assign Base XP Cost for the Species
records.summary: •Base XP cost is determined by the original creatureʼs CR × 500 XP. •If the creature has abilities requiring resources (e.g., spell slots, limited uses per day), discount the cost by 25% to account for their limited usability. 4.List Abilities as Unlockable Powers •All unique abilities (such as breath weapons, magic resistance, or special movement mechanics) are locked at character creation. •Each ability is assigned an XP cost based on its impact on gameplay. •The player can purchase these abilities at character creation if they have the XP, or they can buy them later while advancing their character. 5.Adjust HP & Defenses for Balance •The creatureʼs HP is recalculated using standard character rules (Constitution-based instead of monster hit dice). •If the creature had damage resistances or immunities, apply a tiered unlock system: ◦ Minor resistances (e.g., cold, fire) cost 5,000 XP each. ◦ Major resistances (e.g., psychic, radiant) cost 10,000 XP. ◦ Immunities are not allowed at level 1, but can be bought later. 6.Ability Score Conversion •Ability scores are recalculated using the standard point-buy or roll method. •If the monster had extreme stats (e.g., STR 26, INT 4), convert as follows: ◦ STR, DEX, CON: Start with a +2 to a primary stat that fits the species.
